# The Project's directory, where its sources are (the Project's paths are relative to it).
get_filename_component(_cppbuild_project_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../ECOJobBench" ABSOLUTE)

_cppbuild_collect_sources(_cppbuild_sources _cppbuild_modules "src" "include")

add_executable(ECOJobBench ${_cppbuild_sources})
set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "ECOJobBench")
# Visual Studio debugs in the Project directory, where CppBuild's run and the tests start too.
set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY "${_cppbuild_project_dir}")
target_include_directories(ECOJobBench PRIVATE "${_cppbuild_project_dir}/include")
target_compile_options(ECOJobBench PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:CXX,MSVC>:/utf-8;/Zc:__cplusplus>" "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:C,MSVC>:/utf-8>")
target_link_libraries(ECOJobBench PRIVATE ECOJob::ECOJob_static)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(ECOJobBench PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:/W3>")
endif()
set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(DEFINED ECOJob_ECOJobBench_CXX_STANDARD)
  set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD ${ECOJob_ECOJobBench_CXX_STANDARD})
endif()
if(ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
  set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
  )
endif()
set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_COMPILED_TARGETS ECOJobBench)
if(_cppbuild_modules)
  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.28)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ECOJobBench has C++ module interface units, which need CMake 3.28 or later")
  endif()
  target_sources(ECOJobBench PRIVATE FILE_SET cppbuild_modules TYPE CXX_MODULES
    BASE_DIRS "${_cppbuild_project_dir}" FILES ${_cppbuild_modules})
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_MODULE_TARGETS ECOJobBench)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  # DLLs the program loads (imported libraries, libraries with their own output directory)
  # beside it, so it starts from Visual Studio, CppBuild's run or the tests alike.
  add_custom_command(TARGET ECOJobBench POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E "$<IF:$<BOOL:$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:ECOJobBench>>,copy_if_different,true>"
      "$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:ECOJobBench>" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:ECOJobBench>" COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS VERBATIM)
endif()
if(DISPLAY IN_LIST CPPBUILD_REQUESTED AND NOT CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
  # Listed for the IDE only: shown, but not part of the default build.
  set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD ON)
  if(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY AND CPPBUILD_LINKED_OUTPUT AND NOT ECOJob_ECOJobBench_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
    # Programs of different Solutions may share a file name.
    set_target_properties(ECOJobBench PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${CPPBUILD_LINKED_OUTPUT}")
  endif()
endif()
